NAME: Patient ID
DESCRIPTION: Unique patient identifier.

NAME: Index date
DESCRIPTION: Date on which the patient satisfied cohort criteria.

NAME: Age
DESCRIPTION: Patient age in years at the index date.

NAME: Gender
DESCRIPTION: Patient gender.

NAME: Race
DESCRIPTION: Patient race.

NAME: Ethnicity
DESCRIPTION: Patient ethnicity.

NAME: Any qualifying GI or Crohn's procedure on or after index date
DESCRIPTION: Indicates whether the patient had **any qualifying GI or Crohn's procedure** on or after their index date within the study period.

NAME: CDAI or Harvey-Bradshaw Index assessment in 30-day pre-procedure window
DESCRIPTION: Indicates whether the patient had at least one **CDAI or Harvey-Bradshaw Index assessment** recorded in the 30 days before any gastrointestinal or Crohn's procedure.

NAME: CDAI or Harvey-Bradshaw Index assessment in 60-day pre-procedure window
DESCRIPTION: Indicates whether the patient had at least one **CDAI or Harvey-Bradshaw Index assessment** recorded in the 60 days before any gastrointestinal or Crohn's procedure.

NAME: CRP or fecal calprotectin measurement in 30-day pre-procedure window
DESCRIPTION: Indicates whether the patient had at least one **CRP or fecal calprotectin measurement** recorded in the 30 days before any gastrointestinal or Crohn's procedure.

NAME: CRP or fecal calprotectin measurement in 60-day pre-procedure window
DESCRIPTION: Indicates whether the patient had at least one **CRP or fecal calprotectin measurement** recorded in the 60 days before any gastrointestinal or Crohn's procedure.

NAME: Emergency Room or Urgent Care visit for Crohn's disease flare post-index
DESCRIPTION: Indicates whether the patient had an **Emergency Room or Urgent Care visit for Crohn's disease flare** (primary Crohn's diagnosis, excluding remission) with visit start on or after the index date and within the study period.

NAME: Inpatient hospitalization for Crohn's disease flare on or after index date
DESCRIPTION: Indicates whether the patient had at least one **inpatient hospitalization for Crohn's disease flare** (active Crohn's disease or complication as primary diagnosis) on or after the index date.

NAME: Abdominal mass condition in 30-day pre-procedure window
